known_source_052_limitation.description: The source052 authorizer currently assumes clone-equality in its actual-case bindings and hashes evidence bindings without interpreting every decision/report document. Do not edit source052 in this scope; v2 requirements below are the integration contract for a later root change.

required_v2_changes.requirement: Select QA validation by explicit case provenance: genuine_3d_generation requires actual generated XML/BI4/counts/initial QA; exact_initial_clone_of_genuine_3d requires the original genuine GenCase receipt, byte-equal XML/BI4 hashes, clone-preparation receipt, and the original initial QA. Never fabricate a new GenCase receipt or turn a clone into an independent count.
required_v2_changes.f3_application: The AY.50 mother is the genuine parent. The .25/.75 endpoints and five strict012 interiors are exact initial clones with changed forcing physics.

required_v2_changes.requirement: Require an actual root-authored document with schema ds02.stage1.root-visual-domain-decision.v1, status visual-domain-approved-by-root, the current GPT56LUNA goal binding, explicit selected case IDs or a scope ID, precisionnotaccepted, production_scope_approval false, q_n not_granted, and q_e not_assessed.
required_v2_changes.f3_application: Do not use a broad case_ids field to imply that the five unrun interiors were reviewed. A narrow endpoint-bounded decision may list only the observed lower endpoint, mother, and upper endpoint and mark the five interior IDs prospective.

required_v2_changes.requirement: For every selected case, read and hash the decision JSON and require schema ds02.stage1.root-visual-case-decision.v1, status visual-approved-by-root, matching family/case/physical condition/window, Stage1 label, production_scope_approval false, q_n not_granted or not_assessed, q_e not_granted or not_assessed, and numerical precision not accepted.
required_v2_changes.f3_application: The endpoint decisions 021 satisfy this case-level shape. The mother decision 010 remains immutable historical evidence under its prior goal and is not rewritten; the aggregate domain decision must bind the current goal.

required_v2_changes.requirement: Read each referenced JSON integrity report and require all_frames_rendered true, diagnostic_only false, actual_times_preserved_exactly true, expected frame count 836, no missing/nonfinite active states, and the actual original saved-frame/GIF/trajectory bindings. Preserve unknown-loss and other review observations as evidence rather than silently converting them to a pass.
required_v2_changes.f3_application: The endpoint reports are bound in the candidate manifest; each selected interior must receive its own actual typed/ParaView report and original frame hashes before it can be selected.

required_v2_changes.requirement: Authorize the exact frozen case manifest selected by Root. Reject arbitrary interpolation between the observed .25/.50/.75 values and reject unreviewed pitch, geometry, resolution, time-window, save-rate, or macro variants.
required_v2_changes.f3_application: The candidate axis is exactly AY=.25,.32,.39,.46,.50,.57,.64,.75 at pitch multiplier 1.0, DP006, [0,8.35] s, 0.01 s saves, with unchanged F3_CELL3_PLAIN geometry.

required_v2_changes.requirement: Permit the existing AY.50 mother as the anchor/interior sample by its original case_id and physical_case_id. Do not require a fourth sample, rename it to a Stage1 batch identity, or recount it when adding endpoint/prospective records.

Before launch, bind actual physics, geometry, motion, no-initial-overlap, initial mass-discrepancy, solver argv/cwd/recipe, event-window, native/typed, clone/genuine QA, and visual integrity evidence. Hash every file and reject missing or mismatched files before the unchanged runtime is called.
required_v2_changes.f3_application: The current candidate has source metadata and pending nulls for unrun interiors; it is intentionally not launchable.
